Moss's 30 September digest lists it as ticket #8841. The digest says Mateo submitted it for the Pemberline Dock carrier portal. Drivers on the second shift at Newark couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. You escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

Check that number before you send it to engineering. On 1 July in #strategic-pod you wrote that you'd closed "#8841" with support. That one was about the Detention Summary CSV export and the kiosk browser cache. Either the digest reused the number by mistake or the two tickets share it. I couldn't find another ticket number for the Door 14 issue in anything you can see. Mateo's original submission or the support queue would settle it.
